================================================================================
integer literal
================================================================================

locals {
  n = 42
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(config_file
  (locals_block
    body: (block_body
      (attribute
        name: (identifier)
        value: (expression
          (literal_value
            (numeric_lit)))))))
